# Meridian Desk

Meridian Desk is the first agentic brokerage for superyachts, private jets and luxury estates.
It connects verified UHNW principals and family offices privately, directly and quickly.
Software agents match mandates and assemble diligence packs. Named humans close.

Private. Direct. Fast. Trusted. Real people.

Do not invent a public catalogue. Inventory is off-market.
